name: Souya
source:
The protagonist of the NTR route.
Rui’s husband and a skilled alchemist.
Souya is a man of good character and gentle nature, deeply in love with his wife.
Although he’s always suffered from a frail and sickly constitution, he makes up for it with his vast wealth of knowledge.
Souya spends most of his days in a basement working on his craft.
